Landing.metaTitle: Design your REST API before you build it
Landing.eyebrow: A workspace for REST API design
Landing.heroSubtitle: Map your endpoints, connect your schemas, and get the structure right. A visual workspace for developers, from first idea to OpenAPI.
Landing.heroNote: No credit card required. Export your design when you need it.
Landing.proof: Built around the standards you use
Landing.benefitsCopy: Not in scattered notes or separate files. Keep your endpoints, data shapes, and auth in one API Design.

structure.title: See what connects.
structure.copy: Trace an endpoint to its response schema and auth requirements. Make those decisions before they become code.

perspective.title: Big picture. Small details.
perspective.copy: Explore connections on the canvas. Switch to Flat Mode to focus on the details. The same design, either way.

assistant.title: Skip the blank canvas.
assistant.copy: Describe what you want to build. Let the AI assistant create a starting point, then review and refine the design.

Landing.taglineCopy: Work out the shape of your API while changes are still design decisions, not code rewrites.
Landing.workflowTitle: A clear path to your first export.
Landing.workflowCopy: Start with a resource. Add the details. Take the result into the tools you already use.

define.title: Give your API a shape.
define.copy: Create resources like Books or Orders. Add endpoints with methods, paths, and query parameters.

connect.title: Make the contract explicit.
connect.copy: Define reusable request and response schemas. Connect auth schemes so each endpoint says what it needs.

export.title: Take it into your workflow.
export.copy: Export OpenAPI as YAML or JSON, or download a Postman collection. Your design is not tied to the editor.

Landing.faqCopy: What API Builder does, what it does not, and where your design goes next.

purpose.question: What can I design here?
purpose.answer: REST APIs with resources, endpoints, query parameters, reusable JSON Schemas, and auth schemes. Each API Design keeps these parts together in your workspace.

code.question: Does this build or host my backend?
code.answer: No. API Builder is a design tool. It helps you define the API contract and export it. You implement and host the backend with your own tools.

modes.question: Do I have to use the canvas?
modes.answer: No. Flat Mode lets you work through tabbed lists and a detail panel. You can switch between Canvas Mode and Flat Mode without creating a separate design.

ai.question: Do I need AI to use it?
ai.answer: No. You can create and edit everything yourself. The AI assistant is an optional way to turn a description into a starting design. Review its output before using it.

exports.question: What can I export?
exports.answer: An OpenAPI 3.0 document in YAML or JSON, or a Postman collection. Copy the generated output or download it from the editor.

account.question: Do I need an account?
account.answer: Yes. Sign in to create and save API Designs in your personal workspace. No credit card is required. You can explore the example above without an account.

Landing.finalCopy: Turn the idea in your head into a design you can build from.
Landing.footerCopy: A little more thought before a lot more code.
